chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Tha'laba ibn Maimun, from Mu'mar ibn Umar, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The most sincere of names is what is named with servitude (to Allah), and the best of them are the names of the Prophets, Allah's blessings be upon them all.

key_terms.الْعَبُودِيَّةُ: Servitude or slavery to God, indicating humility and recognition of divine lordship

ai.seo_question: What is considered the most sincere and best name in Islamic tradition according to the Imams?
